rationale: dual_domain_bilateral_n2i-claude-agentic: warm_start=True, pretrain_epochs=3, train_n=200, n_iter=300, val_n=16, batch_size=1, grad_clip=1.0, lr=0.005, proj_n_bf=1, img_n_bf=3, img_sr=0.0005, proj_sr=0.0005, img_sx=2.5, img_sy=2.5, outer_wall_s=1500, seed=7, rationale=iter-17, CEILING-DOCUMENTATION confirmation probe (NOT a ceiling-raiser). Base = the iter-12 CHAMPION (SSIM 0.974822, PSNR 38.63 dB; proj_n_bf=1, proj_sr=0.0005, img_n_bf=3, img_sr=0.0005, img_sx=img_sy=2.5, n_iter=300, seed=42). ONE KNOB CHANGED: seed 42 -> 7 (isolated; a THIRD fresh seed). EVERYTHING else identical to the iter-12 champion (warm_start=True, pretrain_epochs=3, train_n=200, n_iter=300, val_n=16, batch_size=1, grad_clip=1.0, lr=5e-3, proj_n_bf=1, img_n_bf=3, img_sr=0.0005, proj_sr=0.0005, img_sx=img_sy=2.5; proj_sx/proj_sy/img_kernel/proj_kernel at Wagner-abdomen defaults). WHY A 2ND FRESH SEED IS THE HONEST PROBE: ALL knob families are exhausted and characterized -- IMAGE-domain (range img_sr tight peak, depth img_n_bf=3 peak, kernel img_kernel 7->9 flat @iter-6, spatial img_sx/img_sy full 0.5/1.5/2.5/3.5 sweep flat) and PROJECTION-domain (range proj_sr=0.0005 peak / 0.0001 flat, depth proj_n_bf=2 flat, spatial proj_sx 1.0->0.5 DOWN @iter-14, proj_sy 2.0->0.5 flat @iter-15), plus n_iter (300->600 flat @iter-7) and pretrain_epochs. No ceiling-raiser remains. iter-16 already flipped seed 42->123 and landed 0.974834 (within +0.00001 of the iter-12 champion 0.974822) -- seed-robust on a SECOND seed. iter-17 is the THIRD seed (7), turning a 2-seed pair into a 3-seed reproducibility set so the 0.9748 ceiling is documented as a substrate property across THREE independent inits, not a 2-seed coincidence. HYPOTHESIS: seed 42->7 lands SSIM at ~0.9748 (within +-0.0005 of the iter-12/16 cluster 0.974822 / 0.974834). The 12-param bilateral has too few DOF to be seed-sensitive (only 12 sigma scalars warm-started from an amortized N2I init, then per-scan-fit on each image's OWN measurements -- no pixel-wise memory, no large param space for the seed to swing), and iter-16 already confirmed tight reproduction on seed 123, so seed 7 should reproduce again, SEALING 0.9748 as the breast 128-view FBP-bounded representational ceiling (hr=0, PSNR ~38.63 ~1 dB under the 39.68 dB LD-FBP baseline -- the BF inductive bias approaches but cannot beat a clean 128-view breast FBP, mirroring dd-bf-supervised 0.9502 on Mayo). If instead SSIM swings by >0.0005, the per-scan fit has a seed-dependent noise floor (as demo-n2i's U-Net does) and the bilateral ceiling reads are noisier than assumed -- but the 12-param bilateral physically cannot overfit one scan, so a tight reproduction is expected. WALL: step budget IDENTICAL to iter-12 (n_iter=300, val_n=16; warm <=3x200=600 + per-image 16x300=4800); iter-12 ran 497 s, iter-16 ran 496 s, far under the 1800 s sbatch wall; outer_wall_s=1500 internal guard unchanged. ONE knob changed: seed 42->7 (isolated).
